messages:
nolan: Vendor ProcuraQ sent a revised commercial. New items: "active connection" fee and an explicit embedding serving charge. Can someone quick-check for double-billing?

maya: Skim looks risky. Active connection + throughput overage might overlap for streaming.

amanda: I've asked them for a clean sample invoice and three scenarios: pilot, 12mo commit, 24mo commit. Will upload when received.

jess: Engineering asks: clarify if embedding price is per vector independent of dims, and whether serving (read) traffic vs storage are billed separately. Also insist on data residency guarantees if they host models.

procurement-bot: Task created: PR-2026-200 ProcuraQ commercial review. Approvers: nolan, maya, legal, eng-lead. Link: https://tools.redwood/approvals/PR-2026-200

nolan: Thanks. Quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to decide pilot ask. Drop any vendor docs or sample invoices here.
